◌

Password

Changing it signs out every other device. This one stays signed in.
Confirms every change on this screen
  • At least 12 characters
  • Doesn't contain your account name
  • Both entries match
  • Not a password attackers try first — checked when you save
◌

Username

Your username is the address account recovery goes to, so it has to be one you can read.
◌

Recovery passphrase

A phrase you choose that gets you back in without your password — for when your recovery sheet is at home and you are not.
At least 16 characters, and not your password. Setting one replaces any phrase already saved.

Without it, your recovery codes are the only way back in if you forget your password. This takes effect at once.
